topNews.text: Self-Healing Contact Lenses Repair Scratches with Just 1 Hour of UV Light Exposure
topNews.excerpt: A major, early-stage advancement in vision technology comes to us now from South Korea, where researchers created a contact lens that repairs scratches automatically when exposed to sunlight.
